D. Product Specification and Artwork Status

The Product Specification, Artwork, product text and warnings, NFC destination URL, call to action (CTA), Fresh Perk and offer rules, and integration configurations are approved by Customer’s authorized representative by email confirmation. Customer’s email confirmation constitutes Final Approval and is incorporated into the Agreement at the time of confirmation. FC will retain each such approval record by approver name, title, email address, the time the email was sent and the document version.

Mass production may not begin before the Product Specification and Artwork approvals are complete.
